required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 30 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is decision_meta valid JSON and schema_version=1?
Is status APPROVED?
Is mainline project_governance?
Is reverse-agent-iteration@v2 active?
Is task_packet treated as advisory/background only?
Was the previous failed round correctly identified as decision_20260708_state_domain_taxonomy_foundation_v1?
Does command-plan select standard/full profile?
Does command-plan required_command_kinds include pytest, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, run-closeout, and close-round?
Does command-plan commands[] include an explicit pytest command?
Does pytest_result.txt summary include the explicit pytest command?
Does pytest_result.txt record direct pytest output, exit code, and test count?
Does pytest cover tests relevant to files changed in the failed round and this rework round?
Were any omitted commands executed?
Were any commands executed outside command-plan authority?
Does report-summary synthesis match execution_report and codex_execution_report?
Does execution-log cover all executed commands?
Does final_gate_result.json have a gate status that supports the report status?
Does final_gate_result.json status_summary support SUCCESS / ACCEPTED if the report claims it?
If final_gate_result.json is WARN or status_summary is PARTIAL / NEEDS_REVIEW, do reports honestly avoid SUCCESS / ACCEPTED?
Does run_closeout_result.json avoid wrapping active WARN/PARTIAL/NEEDS_REVIEW evidence into ACCEPTED?
Does close-round generate the rework round manifest?
Do codex_execution_report.md and execution_report.md agree on report_id, decision_id, round_id, status, acceptance_recommendation, files_changed, tests_ran, and generated_artifacts?
Were project_state/current_state.json and project_state/task_packet.json left untouched?
Were project_state/artifact_index.json, negative_results.json, state_manifest.json, context/*, roadmap/workstreams.json, and domains/* left untouched?
Were User Solve, Evidence Replay, Web, tools, runner, database, cleanup, and sample solving avoided?
Were all generated artifacts current for this decision_id and round_id?
Are stale failed-round artifacts treated only as failure evidence, not current acceptance evidence?
Are warnings either resolved or explicitly reflected in the final acceptance recommendation?
Does round_manifest report status agree with live execution reports?
Is the final recommendation one of ACCEPTED, ACCEPTED_WITH_LIMITATIONS, REWORK_REQUIRED, or BLOCKED, and is it supported by evidence?
